info.headline: ORANGE ALERT: Severe heavy rainfall impact forecast for kerala western ghats (Impact Severity Index 6.52/10)
info.description: ORANGE ALERT. kerala western ghats is forecast in the severe-impact class. Recommended action: alert district control rooms, keep NDRF/SDRF on standby, advise suspension of non-essential outdoor activity and verify drainage/embankment readiness.
